Protein Food

Langoustine

About This Entry

Langoustine is a slender clawed crustacean — sweeter and more delicate than large warm-water prawns. Mineral whites, Champagne, and dry rosé suit butter and garlic preparations.

Beginner Guide

Also sold as scampi or Dublin Bay prawn — distinct from large tiger prawn.

FAQ

What is Langoustine?
A cold-water crustacean prized in European seafood cookery.
